title: Arkret Directory Subject Handle List
description: Result body for ak.find.directory.query.list_handles_for_subject. It lists currently visible handle claims for a disclosed holder/principal subject DID in the caller's context. Every claim in claims[] MUST have claim.subject byte-for-byte equal to this response subject.

subject.description: Holder/principal DID used as the reverse lookup key. This is not a Realm actor_id.

claims.description: Current context-visible signed handle claims. Each item MUST have subject equal to the top-level subject; mismatches MUST be dropped or fail the response closed.

primary_handle.description: Optional canonical primary handle selected from claims[] by identity-handles.md section 3.2.1 for the same context/as_of. The @ mention sigil is not part of this field.

as_of.description: As-of timestamp used to build the visible claim set and primary handle selection.
